# Number base converter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/base-converter/

Convert whole numbers between bases 2, 8, 10 and 16 using exact large-integer arithmetic. Preserve values beyond normal floating-point precision.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Convert hexadecimal FF to decimal 255 and binary 11111111.

## Limits and checks

Enter a whole number in the selected base. Fractional radix conversions and signed two’s-complement interpretation are not included.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
